versions.changelog:
- Added CLI entry point and project structure files (cli.js, package.json, src/generator.js, tests/run-tests.js).
- Removed redundant documentation file (skill-card.md).
- Updated SKILL.md with additional metadata fields (slug, displayName, version, updated).
- No functional changes to triage logic or skill prompts; structure and metadata improvements only.

- Major simplification: The skill has been reduced to a single core documentation file (SKILL.md); all code and auxiliary files were removed.
- SKILL.md was edited to streamline required inputs, remove procurement path rules, and clarify trigger-to-closing rules.
- Removed "Return From Closing" section; boundaries and output format remain clear and unchanged.
- Minor updates to sourcing and terminology (e.g., "field-experience" source).
- Documentation now solely guides war-room POC triage; non-essential code, tests, and templates were deleted.
